what: Break types and bottoms a person reviewed. pipeline/import_break_type_research.py writes each named value into the roster as source 'reviewed' (rank 6), after research and memory; nothing ranked below it can overwrite it. Each spot is named exactly as in pipeline/spots_enriched.json, by name and state. An entry names a break_type, a bottom, or both, with a note; a value it does not name is left as research and memory set it.
